name: The Wishing Star
source:
Mlada (by default, the name can be changed) is an ordinary office worker working at her dream job: the senior (and, ahem, so far the only one) assistant to the chief (well, um, only) inspector of artifacts and magical equipment at the Lavila School of Magic at the Coven of Mages. She's sweet and efficient, a little nervous and anxious, but who out here isn't?

One not-so-wonderful day, she finds herself drawn into a not-so-simple adventure in the spirit world, in pursuit of a wish-granting star. But does she, and her new company, need this star as much as they think?

[translated from [url=https://immeria.itch.io/the-wishing-star]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
姆拉达（默认情况下，名字可以更改）是一名普通的办公室职员，从事着她梦想的工作：法师协会拉维拉魔法学院的文物和魔法装备首席（嗯，嗯，唯一的）检查员的高级（咳咳，迄今为止唯一一位）助理。她很可爱，很有效率，但有点紧张和焦虑，但这里谁不是呢？

在一个不那么美好的一天，她发现自己陷入了一场不那么简单的精神世界冒险，寻找一颗如愿之星。但她和她的新公司真的像他们想象的那样需要这位明星吗？

[译自[url=https://immeria.itch.io/the-wishing-star]Itch.io[/url]]
